destination.question: What is an eSIM?
destination.answer: An eSIM is a digital SIM built into your phone. Instead of swapping a physical card, you install a plan by scanning a QR code or tapping a link — no store visit, no waiting.

destination.question: When should I install my eSIM?
destination.answer: You can install it any time after purchase, but we recommend installing before you travel while you still have Wi-Fi. The plan only activates once you connect to a supported network at your destination.

destination.question: Can I keep my regular number?
destination.answer: Yes. Your eSIM adds a second, data-only line alongside your existing SIM, so you keep receiving calls and texts on your regular number.

destination.question: Does my plan include hotspot?
destination.answer: Most SpeedNetRDC plans support personal hotspot / tethering at no extra cost. Check the "Hotspot" field on the plan details page to confirm for your specific plan.

help.question: Can I get a refund?
help.answer: For refund requests, contact us at contact@speednetrdc.com.

help.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
help.answer: Debit and credit cards on Stripe’s secure checkout. Apple Pay and Google Pay are offered on devices that support them.

help.question: How do I contact a human?
help.answer: Email us at contact@speednetrdc.com — we reply within 24 hours. For quick answers to common questions, tap the chat button in the bottom-right corner.
